title: Morning rush in Whitby: every bus, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Whitby, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus inside the town on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Whitby town limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Local and PULSE, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 32 buses at 7:22 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
